layers.process: Glendalough Monastic Site and Visitor Centre lists admission as adult EUR 5.00 (about A$7.95, RBA 30 Oct 2026, A$1 = EUR 0.6293), group or senior EUR 4.00, child or student EUR 3.00, family EUR 13.00. Paying for parking in the Visitor Centre car park gives one free admission to the Visitor Centre. The site is open all year and closed 23 to 29 December.
